how: We read the website of every Nashville wedding videographer listed on Lazo (91 listings, 68 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: venues, planners and DJs that showed up in this category, a photo-booth company, an officiant, an elopement package seller, and a wellness speaker; the list below is shorter because true Nashville wedding filmmakers were thin on the ground. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Will you mic the vows and toasts separately, and how do you handle wind and cicadas at an outdoor summer ceremony?
What exactly is delivered: a highlight film, a full ceremony edit, raw footage, and on what timeline?
Are you shooting photo and video as one team, and if so, who leads when the two need the same moment?

picks.name: Lynn Productions Nashville
picks.blurb: Lynn Productions is a Nashville wedding videography team of filmmakers and editors. Its top package, the Red Carpet, includes 11 hours of coverage with three videographers and a one-minute teaser delivered within a week, so you can see how the tiers scale.

picks.name: Dallas Wilson Wedding Films
picks.blurb: Dallas and Danielle Wilson are a brother-sister cinematography team born and raised in Nashville, with over 300 weddings filmed in the past 10 years. During the week Dallas is a full-time songwriter with cuts by Lainey Wilson and Teddy Swims.

picks.name: With This Ring Wedding Films + Photo
picks.blurb: A Nashville team doing films and photos together, 20 years and 500-plus weddings in, from backyards to Sicilian hillsides. With This Ring's collections pair a full ceremony film and social teaser with an extended cinematic highlight, and all are customizable.

picks.name: Big Hill Productions
picks.blurb: Christian and Camille Lewis are a husband-and-wife team who have shot photography and videography together for 15 years. Christian has been filming since middle school and went full time after shooting his brother's wedding. Big Hill is based in Gallatin.

picks.name: Brogen Davis Photography
picks.blurb: Katherine and Brogen are professional ballroom dancers turned wedding photographers and videographers; Brogen started photographing weddings in 2010 before pausing for dance. Their pitch is against cookie-cutter weddings and generic footage.

picks.name: Nicole Lenia Kiser Imagery
picks.blurb: For couples who want film with a vintage grain, Nicole Lenia Kiser shoots Super 8 alongside documentary wedding and elopement photography. She has photographed and filmed couples in over 25 states and two countries from her Nashville base.

picks.name: Cody Harris – Cinematic Wedding Photographer
picks.blurb: Cody Harris pairs photography with film meant to remember real moments like a movie, shaped by the way the day actually feels rather than a script. Works Nashville, the West Coast and destinations.

picks.name: Greg and Jess Photography and Videography
picks.blurb: Greg and Jess shoot weddings as both photographers and videographers out of Nolensville, documenting moments and telling stories with their cameras. One couple handles both, which simplifies the timeline on the day.

picks.name: Details Nashville
tags: photo and video in one stop
picks.blurb: Details Nashville specializes in wedding photography and videography and adds slow-motion video booths and photo booths from the same company, based in Hermitage. The site asks you to pick the services you want, then talk through the vision of the wedding with them.

picks.name: JB Photography
picks.blurb: JB, James, is a wedding and events photographer and videographer in Franklin and middle Tennessee, assisted by his wife. The site leads with his albums rather than a sales pitch, so you can judge the work directly.
